cards.summary: Google announced its largest AI organization shakeup yet, moving Demis Hassabis into Alphabet’s chief scientist role and assigning DeepMind operations to Koray Kavukcuoglu. Two sources report that Jeff Dean is launching or co-founding the research startup Discovery Loop, with one also naming Sanjay Ghemawat, Oriol Vinyals, and Quoc Le as co-founders.
